summary: Enhance your skills with our Stress Testing and Scenario Analysis training for central banks. Learn practical techniques to manage financial risks effectively.
lede: Central bank stress testing and scenario analysis assess how adverse economic and financial shocks could affect banking-system resilience. For analysts, economists and supervisors, the course develops practical skills in scenario calibration, supervisory-data controls, solvency and liquidity projections, model sensitivity checks, and clear reporting of uncertainty and limitations to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This central bank stress testing course is designed for professionals who analyze banking-system resilience, challenge institutional models or use adverse-scenario evidence to support prudential decisions. It fits roles that already work with financial statements, supervisory data, macroeconomic indicators or bank risk metrics.
prerequisites: Required knowledge: Working familiarity with banking risk, financial statements, prudential ratios and spreadsheet calculations. Coding requirement: No coding is required. Python and R outputs are reviewed through demonstrations, while hands-on exercises use provided Microsoft Excel templates. Advanced-content depth: Solvency, liquidity and validation methods receive operational application. Climate scenarios, network contagion, AI-assisted analytics and programming workflows receive conceptual or operational coverage. Equipment: Bring a laptop capable of running current spreadsheet software. Training datasets and calculation templates are provided.
